stores.title: Choose your stores
stores.description: Prices differ by branch, so pick your preferred store. The branch nearest your Home Assistant location is listed first — change it if you shop elsewhere. Start typing to search.

primary_chain.title: Primary supermarket
primary_chain.description: Choose where you shop most. Its order history is what makes your shopping list accurate.

foodstuffs_auth.title: Foodstuffs (Club+) login
foodstuffs_auth.description: Enter your Club+ email and password. One Club+ login covers both PAK'nSAVE and New World.

woolworths_auth.title: Woolworths login
woolworths_auth.description: Enter your Woolworths email and password.

reauth_confirm.title: Woolworths login
reauth_confirm.description: Your Woolworths login was rejected. Re-enter your email and password.

reauth_foodstuffs.title: Foodstuffs (Club+) login
reauth_foodstuffs.description: Your Club+ login was rejected. Re-enter your email and password.

error.cannot_connect: Login add-on unreachable. Check it's installed and running.
error.addon_failed: The Basket Brain Login add-on couldn't be installed or started. Check the Supervisor logs.

abort.no_supervisor: Basket Brain needs the Login add-on, and that needs Home Assistant OS or Supervised. Container and Core installs aren't supported.
